task.title: P6-005: Wire + Want / + Have into the hover preview, mobile card sheet, and card detail page
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 5 — Missing capability). Original id: P6-005. Size: M. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-design.md.

**Wire `+ Want` / `+ Have` into the hover preview, the mobile card sheet, and the card detail page** (absorbs `P6-103`, which is the same job on the third surface). `design/wireframes.pen` → `Overlay — Card hover preview` carries a `Preview Actions` row (`Preview Want`/`Preview Have`, h=30) and `Mobile — Card sheet` carries `Sheet Actions` (h=40); `design/information-architecture.md:78` names the overlay's contents as "image, key info, **quick actions**, your copies". `app/src/cards.rs` has no Want/Have affordance at all. **On a collection row the preview is the only place those actions could live**, so this is the one gap where a frame draws a control the app does not have. The adapters exist — `QuickAddButton` (`catalog.rs:951`, currently private) and `raise_add_toast`, and destination/toast/tree context is already global via `shell.rs:169`, so this is wiring plus the overlays' own optimistic state, not backend work. Known and deferred by maintainer decision on 2026-07-27: `app-ui` was flipped to `implemented` with this recorded, so `implemented` there means "every screen exists and every other frame reconciles", not "every drawn control is built".
